facts.text: I am looking for gift ideas for my neighbor who is moving into a new place.
I did something similar for a mutual friend last week.
My friends and I chipped in to get a gift card to Bed Bath & Beyond worth $50 for my mutual friend.
I like the idea of a welcome basket.
I want to include kitchen utensils in the welcome basket.
I do not want to break the bank with the gift items.
I will go with the $30 option.
I will include a gift card to Bed Bath & Beyond in the $30 option.
I want ideas on what to write in the note or card.
I do not want the note or card to sound too cheesy or generic.
I will go with the first option, "Simple and Sincere" for the note or card.
